CNN exit-poll files (the National Election Pool survey), from politics.api.cnn.io. Public, no key.

- index_2026.json: https://politics.api.cnn.io/config/exit-poll-dropdown-config/2026-11-03-GE.json
  trimmed to a few states and the Main (0) and Men (20) subsets.
- 2026-GG-PA.json: https://politics.api.cnn.io/results/exit-poll/2026-GG-PA.json before release
  (embargoed until polls close: hasData false, zeros), trimmed to two questions.
- 2024-SG-PA.json: https://politics.api.cnn.io/results/exit-poll/2024-SG-PA.json, a released file
  (2,954 respondents), trimmed to six questions.
